newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's metalworkers meet Confapi employers' group.
newsitem.headline: Italy's metalworkers meet Confapi employers' group.

text.p: Italy's engineering and metalworkers' unions met representatives of employers group Confapi on Wednesday to try to reach an accord in the industry's protracted pay dispute, union sources said.
The sources said the meeting was "positive" and that the parties had agreed on a schedule for further talks.
The Confapi organisation represents 12,000 companies accounting for more than 400,000 of the sector's 1.7 million employees.
Confapi represents small and medium-sized businesses and is one of three employers' groups in the sector, where the bitter pay dispute has been going on since last June.
The largest organisation, Federmeccanica, has given no indication that it is ready to restart talks.
The dispute centres on the interpretation of a landmark 1993 wage deal, which scrapped automatic index linked wage rises. Talks stalled last year.
